ctaHeading: Transform your Yarraville outdoor space today.
aboutText: Totally Outdoors is a family-owned and registered builder based in Yarraville, with over 25 years of experience in transforming outdoor spaces across Melbourne. We specialise in louvered pergolas, carports, and custom outdoor living areas, offering complete end-to-end services from design and permits to construction. Our craftsmanship and dedication have made us a trusted name in the community.
servicesText: At Totally Outdoors, we provide a comprehensive range of outdoor building services tailored to Yarraville homes and businesses. From custom louvered pergola installations and durable carport constructions to complete outdoor living space designs, our team handles every aspect with precision and care.

services.title: Louvered Pergola Installation
services.desc: We design and install custom louvered pergolas that offer adjustable shade and modern style for your outdoor area.

services.title: Carport Construction
services.desc: Build sturdy and functional carports to protect your vehicles, customised to fit your property's requirements.

services.title: Outdoor Living Design
services.desc: Create inviting outdoor living spaces with integrated seating, lighting, and landscaping to enhance your Yarraville home.

services.title: Shade and Sun Solutions
services.desc: Install shade structures and sun protection systems to ensure comfort in your garden, patio, or commercial space.

services.title: Custom Timber and Metal Structures
services.desc: Craft bespoke pergolas, gazebos, and structures using high-quality timber and metal materials for durability.

services.title: End-to-End Project Management
services.desc: We manage all project phases from initial design and permits through construction to final touches, ensuring a seamless experience.
